description:
Find the closest Wayback Machine snapshot of a URL (optionally near a target timestamp). Returns the snapshot URL, its capture timestamp, and HTTP status.

upAPI operation `archive-wayback.get` (Data). Costs 1 unit of monthly quota per call.

timestamp.description: Optional target time YYYYMMDDhhmmss (partial ok). Omit for the newest snapshot.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

url.description: URL to look up in the Wayback Machine
url.title: Url

name: archive_wayback_get
title: Wayback Machine Lookup
